# codebuddy

A simple CLI tool that outputs "Hello, World!"

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g codebuddy
```

## Usage

```bash
codebuddy
```

This will output: `Hello, World!`

## Development

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone <repository-url>
cd codebuddy

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run the CLI
npm start
```

## Publishing

To publish this package to npm:

```bash
npm login
npm publish
```
